summary: This section explains how courts can pause or stop legal actions against a company that is in the process of winding up. When a creditor asks, this protection also applies to legal actions against any contributory of the company. It applies specifically to companies registered under this part of the Act.
points: Applies rules for stopping suits and legal proceedings against a company after a winding up petition is presented.
Applies before a final winding up order is actually made.
Applies to companies registered under this specific part of the law.
Takes effect when a creditor makes an application to stay or restrain proceedings.
Extends protection against legal actions to any contributory of the company.
example: Meera Textiles Private Limited was going through the process of winding up. Before the final winding up order was made, a creditor of the company filed a new lawsuit against Rohan, who was a contributory of Meera Textiles Private Limited. Because the rules on staying legal proceedings extend to contributories when requested by a creditor, the court used its power under this section to pause the lawsuit against Rohan while the company's winding up process continued.

terms.meaning: The legal process of closing down a company and settling its affairs.
A person or business that the company owes money to.
A person liable to contribute to the assets of a company in the event of its being wound up.

watch: Do not assume this protection applies automatically without a creditor making an application to the court.
